purpose: Controlled fixed-budget BC versus reference-regularized BC on new data
variable: Only reference KL coefficient; identical initial checkpoint, data, epochs, seed and action weighting
analysis: Report held-out imitation likelihood, accuracy and action distributions for both arms. These do not establish live strength.
live_selection: The reference-bc hypothesis is the prespecified candidate for fresh live evaluation. Do not choose an arm by the historical 200/400 results or pool historical results.
failure_behavior: Stop if dataset incomplete, receipts invalid or expected collection policy differs; no partial-data fit.
